coordinate_notes: Pixel coordinates [x, y] in the saved file (origin top-left). nose_tip/tail_tip are the board's extreme points on its long axis (null = outside the frame). middle_point is the balance point (halfway nose-tail) on the board centre line, width_at_middle_px the board width there, perpendicular to the axis. For boards with a "mask" these come from the segmentation in maskers/ (tools/tas/sfeer_meet.py).
